lines.en: I drift; my feet barely touch down.
White arms hang at my sides.
I pass through the corridor's shadow.
There's no face under the mask.
I make no sound when I move.
My long thin body sways.
I glide along the wall.
Every step feels like floating.
I head toward the sound of crying.
My hem brushes the floor.
The air turns cold where I pass.

lines.zh: 我从一个房间飘到另一个。
lines.en: I drift from one room to the next.

lines.zh: 走廊尽头的灯跟着我灭。
lines.en: The lights die down the hall behind me.
I don't tread, yet the floor turns cold.
I pass through the half-open door.
I stand like a white pillar.
My mask doesn't move.
Listening for someone hiding.
This white robe has never been soiled.
One scream, and I am gone.
The room's temperature is dropping.

lines.zh: 我数着每一个活物的呼吸。
lines.en: Counting every living breath.
Everyone here fears me.
I don't need to blink.
My shadow is longer than I am.
I wait for the box to be opened.
I'm patient. Always patient.

lines.zh: 你打开了不该开的盒子。
lines.en: You opened a box you shouldn't have.

lines.zh: 你身上有我熟悉的温度。
lines.en: You carry a warmth I remember.
I know your kind of night shift.

lines.zh: 手电照着我，可我不在光里。
lines.en: Your light finds me, but I'm not in it.
Don't step back. It won't help.
I can give you an answer.
Do you hear the music?
Your breathing is shallow.

lines.zh: 这栋楼里，你数到第几个夜班了。
lines.en: How many night shifts have you counted in this building?
You really don't need to run.
I'll follow you. Always.
Don't shut your eyes.
A tear in the white robe.

lines.zh: 我感觉不到疼，只感到空。
lines.en: I feel no pain, only emptiness.
I step back and return.
My mask sits crooked.

lines.zh: 这里面本来就没有东西。
lines.en: There was nothing inside to begin with.

lines.zh: 你打散了影子，影子会重聚。
lines.en: You scattered the shadow. It regathers.
I've grown colder.
You can't hit anything real.
Your hands are up. Lower them slowly.
This body is empty.

lines.zh: 我闻不到你手里的东西。
lines.en: I can't smell what's in your hands.
Keep it. You'll need it.
Let me see what you're holding.
That won't buy you anything.

lines.zh: 你把食物当成护身符了。
lines.en: You're treating food like a charm.
You're clutching that bread too hard.
I don't eat, but I remember hunger.
You passed through me like ice.
Don't touch this white robe.
I don't need to keep my balance.
Back away. It's getting cold.
I'm lighter than I look.
You didn't hit anything solid.

lines.zh: 贴得太近，你会听见声音。
lines.en: Too close and you'll hear things.
I give half a step. Go on.

lines.zh: 你碰到了我的面具边缘。
lines.en: You touched the edge of my mask.

lines.zh: 碰到我的瞬间，你会听见尖叫。
lines.en: The instant you touch me, you'll hear a scream.
I stopped belonging to the living long ago.

lines.zh: 这个身体留着只是为了守着。
lines.en: This body remains only to guard.
I won't have a new beginning.
You're asking an empty shell.
There's nothing under the white robe.

lines.zh: 我的心留在那个盒子里。
lines.en: My heart stayed in that box.
Under the mask, there is no face.
I have only a promise left.
Quiet. Don't speak of it.

lines.zh: 我守的是别人，不是自己。
lines.en: I guard others, not myself.

lines.zh: 我不用手拿，它就浮起来。
lines.en: I don't use hands — it just rises.
I know this box.
I set it on the counter.
An old toy. Very light.
The name on it has worn away.

lines.zh: 我捡起来，只想放回原处。
lines.en: I pick it up only to put it back.

lines.zh: 这东西本来就属于这里。
lines.en: This belonged here all along.

lines.zh: 我拿着它，像拿着旧记忆。
lines.en: Holding it feels like holding a memory.
This shouldn't be taken away.
You set it down. I pick it up.
Your footsteps are heavy.
The box is already open.
Those who should leave never do.

lines.zh: 你的影子在往我这边靠。
lines.en: Your shadow leans toward me.
I'll count slowly to three.

lines.zh: 八音盒的摇柄，我自己转起来了。
lines.en: The music box crank turns itself.
You shouldn't stay here.
The lights are going out one by one.
You've hidden in the locker.

lines.zh: 我的面具停在你的肩后。
lines.en: My mask comes to rest behind your shoulder.

lines.zh: 白袍的下摆已经擦到地板了。
lines.en: The hem of my white robe is already brushing the floor.
I don't need to chase. I can wait.
The room is getting colder.

lines.zh: 你听见音乐盒的声音了吗。
lines.en: Do you hear the music box?
My mask is facing you.
You can't count my footsteps.
I watch your torchlight.

lines.zh: 再等一会儿，你就会回头。
lines.en: A little longer and you'll look back.
My hand reaches into your chest.
This won't hurt. It's only cold.

lines.zh: 我的手指是木头做的，很凉。
lines.en: My fingers are carved wood, and cold.
You're held. You can't move.
The white robe sweeps your face.
I drag you toward the door.
You aren't wounded. But you're afraid.
Your torchlight is flickering.
I let go and you stagger back.
I stand at the end of the corridor.
The white robe falls to the floor.
I float out of the shadow.
The light passes straight through me.
There's no light in the eyes behind the mask.
The air turned cold at once.
Someone opened my box.
I fold my hands in front of me.
The music box has started again.
I lift my head toward the doorway.

lines.zh: 火穿过我，只烧到了白袍。
lines.en: Fire passed through me and only burned the robe.
I fall, light as paper.

lines.zh: 水也淹不住我，只是很沉。
lines.en: Water can't drown me. It only weighs.
The blast scattered me for an instant.

lines.zh: 东西穿过去了，留下一个洞。
lines.en: It went through and left a hole.
That light means to hold me still.
I stopped needing food long ago.

lines.zh: 雷照亮了面具下面的空。
lines.en: Lightning lit the emptiness under the mask.

lines.zh: 这里和我待的地方很像。
lines.en: This place looks like where I've been.
